WITH users_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
),
users_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
      WHERE ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec' AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as distinct_pseudo_users
FROM users_7day u7
WHERE u7.user_pseudo_id NOT IN (SELECT user_pseudo_id FROM users_2day)

-- Final query: Get the top product by total quantity purchased by YouTube buyers (excluding YouTube products)
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` as s,
    UNNEST(s.hits) as h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) as p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
)
SELECT 
  p.v2ProductName as product_name,
  SUM(p.productQuantity) as total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` as s,
  UNNEST(s.hits) as h
CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) as p
JOIN youtube_buyers yb ON s.fullVisitorId = yb.fullVisitorId
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
  AND p.productQuantity > 0
  AND p.v2ProductName NOT LIKE '%YouTube%'
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Get the maximum days_between
WITH last_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date as last_visit_date,
    device.isMobile as last_visit_is_mobile
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date DESC, visitId DESC) = 1
),
first_txn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fullVisitorId,
    date as first_txn_date,
    device.isMobile as first_txn_is_mobile
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC, visitId ASC, h.hitNumber ASC) = 1
),
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
user_events AS (
  SELECT 
    fv.fullVisitorId,
    fv.first_visit_date,
    lv.last_visit_date,
    lv.last_visit_is_mobile,
    ft.first_txn_date,
    ft.first_txn_is_mobile,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(lv.last_visit_date, '00000000'), COALESCE(ft.first_txn_date, '00000000')) as last_recorded_event_date,
    CASE 
      WHEN COALESCE(lv.last_visit_date, '00000000') >= COALESCE(ft.first_txn_date, '00000000') THEN lv.last_visit_is_mobile
      ELSE ft.first_txn_is_mobile
    END as last_event_is_mobile
  FROM first_visit fv
  LEFT JOIN last_visit lv ON fv.fullVisitorId = lv.fullVisitorId
  LEFT JOIN first_txn ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  MAX(DATE_DIFF(
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', last_recorded_event_date), 
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_visit_date), 
    DAY
  )) as longest_days
FROM user_events
WHERE last_event_is_mobile = TRUE

WITH inpatient AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
    AVG(average_medicare_payments * total_discharges) AS yearly_avg_inpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    AND provider_id = '330101'
  GROUP BY year
),
outpatient AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(SUBSTR(_TABLE_SUFFIX, 1, 4) AS INT64) AS year,
    AVG(average_total_payments * outpatient_services) AS yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2015'
    AND provider_id = '330101'
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  i.year,
  i.yearly_avg_inpatient_cost,
  o.yearly_avg_outpatient_cost
FROM inpatient i
JOIN outpatient o ON i.year = o.year
ORDER BY i.year

WITH quinapril_drugs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT drug_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_strength`
  WHERE ingredient_concept_id = 1331235
),
users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
  JOIN quinapril_drugs qd ON de.drug_concept_id = qd.drug_concept_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_persons
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
),
quinapril_users AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as quinapril_user_count
  FROM users
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE((t.total_persons - qu.quinapril_user_count) * 100.0, t.total_persons) as percentage_not_using_quinapril
FROM total t, quinapril_users qu

WITH hurricane_sids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sid, name 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` 
  WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND usa_status IN ('HU', 'HR')
),
storm_tracks AS (
  SELECT 
    h.sid,
    h.name,
    h.iso_time,
    ST_GEOGPOINT(h.longitude, h.latitude) AS pt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
  INNER JOIN hurricane_sids hs ON h.sid = hs.sid
  WHERE h.season = '2020' AND h.basin = 'NA'
),
consecutive_distances AS (
  SELECT
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    pt,
    ST_DISTANCE(pt, LEAD(pt) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time)) AS dist_to_next
  FROM storm_tracks
),
storm_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    SUM(dist_to_next) AS total_distance_meters,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(dist_to_next) DESC) as rn
  FROM consecutive_distances
  GROUP BY sid, name
),
second_hurricane AS (
  SELECT sid FROM storm_distances WHERE rn = 2
)
SELECT latitude 
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes` h
INNER JOIN second_hurricane sh ON h.sid = sh.sid
WHERE h.season = '2020' AND h.basin = 'NA'
ORDER BY h.iso_time DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH storm_points AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    iso_time,
    usa_latitude,
    usa_longitude,
    usa_wind,
    LAG(ST_GEOGPOINT(usa_longitude, usa_latitude)) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS prev_geom,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' AND season = '2020' AND name = 'LAURA'
    AND usa_latitude IS NOT NULL AND usa_longitude IS NOT NULL
),
segment_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    iso_time,
    usa_latitude,
    usa_longitude,
    usa_wind,
    rn,
    COALESCE(ST_DISTANCE(ST_GEOGPOINT(usa_longitude, usa_latitude), prev_geom) / 1000.0, 0) AS segment_km
  FROM storm_points
)
SELECT 
  iso_time,
  usa_latitude,
  usa_longitude,
  usa_wind,
  ROUND(SUM(segment_km) OVER (ORDER BY rn), 2) AS cumulative_distance_km
FROM segment_distances
ORDER BY rn

WITH us_stats AS (
    SELECT g.date,
           AVG(g.max) as avg_max,
           AVG(g.min) as avg_min,
           AVG(g.temp) as avg_temp
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
    WHERE s.country = 'US'
      AND g.date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31'
      AND g.temp != 9999.9
      AND g.max != 9999.9
      AND g.min != 9999.9
    GROUP BY g.date
),
uk_stats AS (
    SELECT g.date,
           AVG(g.max) as avg_max,
           AVG(g.min) as avg_min,
           AVG(g.temp) as avg_temp
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
    WHERE s.country = 'UK'
      AND g.date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2023-10-31'
      AND g.temp != 9999.9
      AND g.max != 9999.9
      AND g.min != 9999.9
    GROUP BY g.date
)
SELECT 
    us.date,
    ROUND(us.avg_max - uk.avg_max, 1) as max_temp_diff,
    ROUND(us.avg_min - uk.avg_min, 1) as min_temp_diff,
    ROUND(us.avg_temp - uk.avg_temp, 1) as avg_temp_diff
FROM us_stats us
JOIN uk_stats uk ON us.date = uk.date
ORDER BY us.date

WITH nearby_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name, lat, lon
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
    ST_GEOGPOINT(lon, lat),
    ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197),
    32186.88
  )
),
temp_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    wban,
    COUNT(*) as valid_temp_observations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2011' AND '2020'
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND temp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stn, wban
)
SELECT 
  ns.usaf,
  ns.wban,
  ns.name,
  ROUND(
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(ns.lon, ns.lat),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(-73.764, 41.197)
    ) / 1609.34, 2  -- convert meters to miles
  ) as distance_miles,
  ns.lat,
  ns.lon,
  COALESCE(tc.valid_temp_observations, 0) as valid_temp_observations
FROM nearby_stations ns
LEFT JOIN temp_counts tc 
  ON ns.usaf = tc.stn AND ns.wban = tc.wban
ORDER BY ns.usaf, ns.wban

WITH complaint_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
temp_data AS (
  SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) as date, AVG(temp) as avg_temp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE stn IN ('725030', '744860') AND temp != 9999.9 AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2008' AND '2017'
  GROUP BY year, mo, da
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as date, complaint_type, COUNT(*) as complaint_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as date, COUNT(*) as total_complaints
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE created_date >= '2008-01-01' AND created_date < '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    t.date,
    t.avg_temp,
    ct.complaint_type,
    COALESCE(dc.complaint_count, 0) as complaint_count,
    dt.total_complaints,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(dc.complaint_count, 0), dt.total_complaints) as pct_complaints
  FROM temp_data t
  JOIN complaint_types ct ON TRUE
  LEFT JOIN daily_complaints dc ON t.date = dc.date AND ct.complaint_type = dc.complaint_type
  LEFT JOIN daily_totals dt ON t.date = dt.date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    complaint_type,
    SUM(complaint_count) as total_complaints,
    COUNT(*) as days_with_temp,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * complaint_count) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(complaint_count),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) - POWER(SUM(avg_temp), 2)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(complaint_count * complaint_count) - POWER(SUM(complaint_count), 2)))
    ) as pearson_r_temp_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * pct_complaints) - SUM(avg_temp) * SUM(pct_complaints),
      SQRT((COUNT(*) * SUM(avg_temp * avg_temp) - POWER(SUM(avg_temp), 2)) * 
           (COUNT(*) * SUM(pct_complaints * pct_complaints) - POWER(SUM(pct_complaints), 2)))
    ) as pearson_r_temp_pct
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING SUM(complaint_count) > 5000
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  total_complaints,
  days_with_temp,
  ROUND(pearson_r_temp_count, 4) as pearson_r_temp_count,
  ROUND(pearson_r_temp_pct, 4) as pearson_r_temp_pct
FROM stats
WHERE ABS(pearson_r_temp_count) > 0.5
ORDER BY ABS(pearson_r_temp_count) DESC

WITH y1995_base AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as latin,
    spc_common,
    status,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common, status
),
y1995_common_ranked AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin ORDER BY SUM(cnt) DESC) as rn
  FROM y1995_base
  GROUP BY latin, spc_common
),
y1995_common AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common FROM y1995_common_ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
y1995_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    b.latin,
    c.spc_common as common_name,
    SUM(b.cnt) as total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status IN ('Good', 'Excellent', 'Fair', 'Critical', 'Poor') THEN b.cnt ELSE 0 END) as alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'Dead' THEN b.cnt ELSE 0 END) as dead_count
  FROM y1995_base b
  JOIN y1995_common c ON b.latin = c.latin
  GROUP BY b.latin, c.spc_common
),
y2015_base AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(spc_latin) as latin,
    spc_common,
    status,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015`
  WHERE spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(spc_latin), spc_common, status
),
y2015_common_ranked AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin ORDER BY SUM(cnt) DESC) as rn
  FROM y2015_base
  GROUP BY latin, spc_common
),
y2015_common AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common FROM y2015_common_ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
y2015_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    b.latin,
    c.spc_common as common_name,
    SUM(b.cnt) as total_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'Alive' THEN b.cnt ELSE 0 END) as alive_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'Dead' THEN b.cnt ELSE 0 END) as dead_count
  FROM y2015_base b
  JOIN y2015_common c ON b.latin = c.latin
  GROUP BY b.latin, c.spc_common
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(a.latin, b.latin) as latin,
    COALESCE(a.common_name, b.common_name) as common_name,
    COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) as total_1995,
    COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) as total_2015,
    COALESCE(a.alive_count, 0) as alive_1995,
    COALESCE(b.alive_count, 0) as alive_2015,
    COALESCE(a.dead_count, 0) as dead_1995,
    COALESCE(b.dead_count, 0) as dead_2015
  FROM y1995_agg a
  FULL OUTER JOIN y2015_agg b ON a.latin = b.latin
  WHERE COALESCE(a.total_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(b.total_count, 0) > 0
)
SELECT 
  latin,
  common_name,
  total_1995,
  total_2015,
  alive_1995,
  alive_2015,
  dead_1995,
  dead_2015,
  total_2015 - total_1995 as total_growth,
  alive_2015 - alive_1995 as alive_growth,
  dead_2015 - dead_1995 as dead_growth
FROM joined
ORDER BY total_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    tz.borough as pickup_borough,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.tip_amount = 0 THEN 'no tip'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 5 THEN 'Less than 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 5 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 10 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 15 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 20 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 25 THEN 'More than 25%'
    END as tip_category
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.data_file_month = 1
    AND DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-07'
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
),
category_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    tip_category,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM filtered_trips
  GROUP BY pickup_borough, tip_category
),
total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_borough,
    SUM(trip_count) as total_trips
  FROM category_counts
  GROUP BY pickup_borough
)
SELECT 
  cc.pickup_borough,
  cc.tip_category,
  cc.trip_count,
  tc.total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(cc.trip_count, tc.total_trips) as proportion
FROM category_counts cc
JOIN total_counts tc ON cc.pickup_borough = tc.pickup_borough
ORDER BY cc.pickup_borough, 
  CASE cc.tip_category
    WHEN 'no tip' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Less than 5%' THEN 2
    WHEN '5% to 10%' THEN 3
    WHEN '10% to 15%' THEN 4
    WHEN '15% to 20%' THEN 5
    WHEN '20% to 25%' THEN 6
    WHEN 'More than 25%' THEN 7
  END

WITH clay AS (
  SELECT st.trip_id, st.stop_sequence, st.departure_time
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st
  WHERE st.stop_id = 14015
),
sacramento AS (
  SELECT st.trip_id, st.stop_sequence, st.arrival_time
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st
  WHERE st.stop_id = 16294
),
valid_trips AS (
  SELECT c.trip_id, c.departure_time as clay_departure, 
         s.arrival_time as sacramento_arrival
  FROM clay c
  JOIN sacramento s ON c.trip_id = s.trip_id
  WHERE c.stop_sequence < s.stop_sequence
)
SELECT t.route_id, t.trip_headsign, 
       FORMAT_TIME('%H:%M:%S', MIN(vt.clay_departure)) as earliest_clay_departure,
       FORMAT_TIME('%H:%M:%S', MAX(vt.sacramento_arrival)) as latest_sacramento_arrival
FROM valid_trips vt
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` t ON CAST(vt.trip_id AS STRING) = t.trip_id
GROUP BY t.route_id, t.trip_headsign
ORDER BY t.route_id

SELECT 
    c.country_name,
    c.country_code,
    c.cumulative_confirmed,
    w.year_2018 as population_2018,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cumulative_confirmed, w.year_2018) * 100, 4) as percentage_confirmed
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data` c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` w
    ON c.iso_3166_1_alpha_3 = w.country_code
WHERE c.date = '2020-06-30'
    AND c.aggregation_level = 0
    AND w.year_2018 IS NOT NULL
    AND w.country NOT LIKE '%total%'
    AND w.country NOT LIKE '%income%'
    AND w.country NOT LIKE '%dividend%'
    AND w.country NOT LIKE '%World%'
    AND w.country NOT LIKE '%countries%'
    AND w.country NOT LIKE '%East Asia%'
    AND w.country NOT LIKE '%Latin%'
ORDER BY percentage_confirmed DESC

WITH daily_new AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    county,
    state_name,
    confirmed_cases,
    confirmed_cases - LAG(confirmed_cases) OVER (PARTITION BY county, state_name ORDER BY date) AS new_cases
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_nyt.us_counties`
  WHERE state_name = 'Illinois'
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-05-31'
),
top5_daily_counties AS (
  SELECT date, county, new_cases,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY new_cases DESC) as rn
  FROM daily_new
  WHERE new_cases > 0
),
county_freq AS (
  SELECT county, COUNT(*) as frequency
  FROM top5_daily_counties
  WHERE rn <= 5
  GROUP BY county
)
SELECT county, frequency
FROM county_freq
ORDER BY frequency DESC, county ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH wa_tracts AS (
  SELECT geo_id, tract_geom, area_land_meters
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '53'
),
acs_tracts AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, income_per_capita
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '53%'
),
zip_codes_wa AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_name = 'Washington'
),
point_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833) AS pt
),
target_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM zip_codes_wa, point_geom
  WHERE ST_DISTANCE(zip_code_geom, pt) < 5 * 1609.34
),
tract_zip_overlap AS (
  SELECT 
    w.geo_id,
    a.total_pop,
    a.income_per_capita,
    t.zip_code,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(w.tract_geom, t.zip_code_geom)) AS overlap_area,
    ST_AREA(w.tract_geom) AS tract_area
  FROM wa_tracts w
  JOIN acs_tracts a ON w.geo_id = a.geo_id
  JOIN target_zips t ON ST_INTERSECTS(w.tract_geom, t.zip_code_geom)
  WHERE ST_AREA(w.tract_geom) > 0
)
SELECT 
  zip_code,
  ROUND(SUM(total_pop * SAFE_DIVIDE(overlap_area, tract_area)), 1) AS total_population,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(income_per_capita * total_pop * SAFE_DIVIDE(overlap_area, tract_area)),
              SUM(total_pop * SAFE_DIVIDE(overlap_area, tract_area))), 1) AS avg_individual_income
FROM tract_zip_overlap
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH top_venues AS (

biggest_championship_margins AS (

highest_scoring_games AS (

total_threes AS (

WITH

        UNION ALL
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL

-- 2017 quarterly wages for Allegheny County
wages_2017 AS (

        UNION ALL

        UNION ALL
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL

    )
),
-- Pittsburgh CPI for 1998 and 2017
cpi_data AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        AVG(value) as avg_cpi
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u` 
    WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' 
      AND item_name = 'All items'

SELECT 
    ROUND((w2017.avg_wkly_wage - w1998.avg_wkly_wage) / w1998.avg_wkly_wage * 100, 2) as wage_growth_pct,
    ROUND((c2017.avg_cpi - c1998.avg_cpi) / c1998.avg_cpi * 100, 2) as cpi_growth_pct,
    w1998.avg_wkly_wage as avg_wkly_wage_1998,

    c1998.avg_cpi as avg_cpi_1998,

WITH distinct_minutes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    CAST(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_seconds, 60)) AS INT64) as duration_minutes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds IS NOT NULL AND trip_seconds BETWEEN 60 AND 3000
),
minutes_with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    duration_minutes,
    NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY duration_minutes) as quantile_group
  FROM distinct_minutes
),
trip_minutes AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trip_seconds,
    t.fare,
    CAST(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(t.trip_seconds, 60)) AS INT64) as duration_minutes,
    mwq.quantile_group
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips` t
  JOIN minutes_with_quantile mwq ON CAST(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(t.trip_seconds, 60)) AS INT64) = mwq.duration_minutes
  WHERE t.trip_seconds IS NOT NULL AND t.trip_seconds BETWEEN 60 AND 3000
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    tm.quantile_group,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips,
    AVG(tm.fare) as avg_fare,
    MIN(tm.duration_minutes) as min_min,
    MAX(tm.duration_minutes) as max_min
  FROM trip_minutes tm
  GROUP BY tm.quantile_group
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT('%02dm to %02dm', gs.min_min, gs.max_min) as time_range,
  gs.total_trips,
  FORMAT('%.2f', gs.avg_fare) as avg_fare
FROM group_stats gs
ORDER BY gs.min_min

WITH pc_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    'postal_code' AS granularity,
    SUM(count_qualified) AS total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) AS avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) AS avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) AS total_panels,
    SUM(kw_total) AS total_kw,
    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) AS total_energy_kwh,
    SUM(carbon_offset_metric_tons) AS total_carbon_offset,
    SUM(existing_installs_count) AS current_installs,
    SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0) - SUM(existing_installs_count) AS installation_gap
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_postal_code`
  GROUP BY state_name
),
ct_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    'census_tract' AS granularity,
    SUM(count_qualified) AS total_buildings,
    AVG(percent_covered) AS avg_percent_covered,
    AVG(percent_qualified) AS avg_percent_qualified,
    SUM(number_of_panels_total) AS total_panels,
    SUM(kw_total) AS total_kw,
    SUM(yearly_sunlight_kwh_total) AS total_energy_kwh,
    SUM(carbon_offset_metric_tons) AS total_carbon_offset,
    SUM(existing_installs_count) AS current_installs,
    SUM(count_qualified * percent_covered / 100.0 * percent_qualified / 100.0) - SUM(existing_installs_count) AS installation_gap
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sunroof_solar.solar_potential_by_censustract`
  GROUP BY state_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT * FROM pc_agg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM ct_agg
)
SELECT 
  state_name,
  granularity,
  ROUND(total_buildings) AS total_buildings,
  ROUND(avg_percent_covered, 2) AS avg_percent_covered,
  ROUND(avg_percent_qualified, 2) AS avg_percent_qualified,
  ROUND(total_panels) AS total_panels,
  ROUND(total_kw, 2) AS total_kw,
  ROUND(total_energy_kwh) AS total_energy_kwh,

  ROUND(current_installs) AS current_installs,
  ROUND(installation_gap) AS installation_gap
FROM combined
WHERE state_name >= 'Oklahoma'
ORDER BY state_name, granularity

WITH region_variants AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_variants,
    SUM(AN) AS total_AN
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1' AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
),
allele_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(ab.AC) AS total_AC
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`,
  UNNEST(alternate_bases) AS ab
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1' AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
),
gene_symbols AS (
  SELECT 
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT v.SYMBOL, ', ' ORDER BY v.SYMBOL) AS distinct_genes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.gnomAD.v3_genomes__chr1`,
  UNNEST(alternate_bases) AS ab,
  UNNEST(ab.vep) AS v
  WHERE reference_name = 'chr1' AND start_position BETWEEN 55039447 AND 55064852
)
SELECT 
  rv.num_variants,
  ac.total_AC AS total_allele_count,
  rv.total_AN AS total_number_of_alleles,
  gs.distinct_genes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(55064852 - 55039447, rv.num_variants) AS mutation_density
FROM region_variants rv
CROSS JOIN allele_counts ac
CROSS JOIN gene_symbols gs

SELECT
  a.consecutive_number,
  a.county,
  a.type_of_intersection,
  a.light_condition,
  a.atmospheric_conditions_1,
  a.hour_of_crash,
  a.functional_system,
  a.related_factors_crash_level_1 AS related_factors,
  CASE WHEN a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital BETWEEN 0 AND 23 THEN a.hour_of_ems_arrival_at_hospital - a.hour_of_crash ELSE NULL END AS delay_to_hospital,
  CASE WHEN a.hour_of_arrival_at_scene BETWEEN 0 AND 23 THEN a.hour_of_arrival_at_scene - a.hour_of_crash ELSE NULL END AS delay_to_scene,
  p.age,
  p.person_type,
  p.seating_position,
  CASE p.restraint_system_helmet_use
    WHEN 0 THEN 0
    WHEN 1 THEN 0.33
    WHEN 2 THEN 0.67
    WHEN 3 THEN 1.0
    ELSE 0.5
  END AS restraint,
  CASE WHEN p.injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS survived,
  CASE WHEN p.rollover LIKE '%Rollover%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rollover,
  CASE WHEN p.air_bag_deployed BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS airbag,
  CASE WHEN p.police_reported_alcohol_involvement LIKE '%Yes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS alcohol,
  CASE WHEN p.police_reported_drug_involvement LIKE '%Yes%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS drugs,
  p.related_factors_person_level1,
  v.travel_speed,
  CASE WHEN v.travel_speed IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS speeding_related,
  v.extent_of_damage,
  v.body_type,
  v.vehicle_removal,
  CASE WHEN v.manner_of_collision > 11 THEN 11 ELSE v.manner_of_collision END AS manner_of_collision,
  CASE WHEN v.roadway_surface_condition > 11 THEN 11 ELSE v.roadway_surface_condition END AS roadway_surface_condition,
  CASE WHEN v.first_harmful_event >= 90 THEN 0 ELSE v.first_harmful_event END AS first_harmful_event,
  CASE WHEN v.most_harmful_event >= 90 THEN 0 ELSE v.most_harmful_event END AS most_harmful_event
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2015` p
  ON a.state_number = p.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = p.consecutive_number
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2015` v
  ON a.state_number = v.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = v.consecutive_number
  AND p.vehicle_number = v.vehicle_number

WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(CoC_Number, 1, 2) as state_abbr,
    Count_Year,
    SUM(Unsheltered_Homeless) as total_unsheltered
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_hud_pit_homelessness.hud_pit_by_coc`
  WHERE Count_Year IN (2015, 2018)
  GROUP BY state_abbr, Count_Year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT 
    state_abbr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2015 THEN total_unsheltered END) as count_2015,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Count_Year = 2018 THEN total_unsheltered END) as count_2018
  FROM state_counts
  GROUP BY state_abbr
),
pct_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    state_abbr,
    count_2015,
    count_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(count_2018 - count_2015, count_2015) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM pivoted
  WHERE count_2015 > 0
),
national_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
  FROM pct_changes
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.state_abbr,
    pc.pct_change,
    na.avg_pct_change,
    ABS(pc.pct_change - na.avg_pct_change) as abs_diff,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(pc.pct_change - na.avg_pct_change)) as rn
  FROM pct_changes pc, national_avg na
)
SELECT state_abbr, pct_change, avg_pct_change, abs_diff, rn
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5

WITH comment_on_question AS (
  SELECT c.user_id, q.tags AS question_tags
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.comments` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON c.post_id = q.id
  WHERE c.creation_date >= TIMESTAMP('2019-07-01')
    AND c.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2020-01-01')
    AND c.user_id BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208
),
comment_on_answer AS (
  SELECT c.user_id, q.tags AS question_tags
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.comments` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON c.post_id = a.id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE c.creation_date >= TIMESTAMP('2019-07-01')
    AND c.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2020-01-01')
    AND c.user_id BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208
),
answer_contrib AS (
  SELECT pa.owner_user_id AS user_id, q.tags AS question_tags
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON pa.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE pa.creation_date >= TIMESTAMP('2019-07-01')
    AND pa.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2020-01-01')
    AND pa.owner_user_id BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208
),
question_contrib AS (
  SELECT pq.owner_user_id AS user_id, pq.tags AS question_tags
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq
  WHERE pq.creation_date >= TIMESTAMP('2019-07-01')
    AND pq.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2020-01-01')
    AND pq.owner_user_id BETWEEN 16712208 AND 18712208
)
SELECT user_id, question_tags FROM comment_on_question
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, question_tags FROM comment_on_answer
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, question_tags FROM answer_contrib
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, question_tags FROM question_contrib
ORDER BY user_id, question_tags

WITH qualifying_questions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id as question_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
     OR SAFE_DIVIDE(a.score, q.view_count) > 0.01
),
question_details AS (
  SELECT 
    q.id as question_id,
    LENGTH(q.body) as body_length,
    q.owner_user_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN qualifying_questions qq ON qq.question_id = q.id
),
badge_counts AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as badge_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT 
  qd.question_id,
  qd.body_length,
  u.reputation,
  (u.up_votes - u.down_votes) as net_votes,
  COALESCE(bc.badge_count, 0) as badge_count
FROM question_details qd
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON u.id = qd.owner_user_id
LEFT JOIN badge_counts bc ON bc.user_id = qd.owner_user_id
ORDER BY qd.body_length DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH combined AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month,
    'PM10' AS pollutant,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm10_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month,
    'PM2.5 FRM' AS pollutant,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_frm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month,
    'PM2.5 non-FRM' AS pollutant,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.pm25_nonfrm_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month,
    'Volatile Organic Emissions' AS pollutant,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.voc_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month,
    'SO2' AS pollutant,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 10 AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.so2_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
  
  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH) AS month,
    'Lead' AS pollutant,
    AVG(arithmetic_mean) * 100 AS avg_value
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.epa_historical_air_quality.lead_daily_summary`
  WHERE state_name = 'California' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_local) = 2020
    AND arithmetic_mean IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC(date_local, MONTH)
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', month) AS month,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN pollutant = 'PM10' THEN avg_value END), 2) AS pm10,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN pollutant = 'PM2.5 FRM' THEN avg_value END), 2) AS pm25_frm,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN pollutant = 'PM2.5 non-FRM' THEN avg_value END), 2) AS pm25_nonfrm,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN pollutant = 'Volatile Organic Emissions' THEN avg_value END), 2) AS volatile_organic_emissions,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN pollutant = 'SO2' THEN avg_value END), 2) AS so2,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN pollutant = 'Lead' THEN avg_value END), 2) AS lead
FROM combined
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

WITH top10_2021 AS (
  SELECT category_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2021
    AND bottle_volume_ml > 0
  GROUP BY category_name
  ORDER BY AVG(state_bottle_retail / SAFE_DIVIDE(bottle_volume_ml, 1000)) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
category_yearly AS (
  SELECT 
    s.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) AS yr,
    AVG(s.state_bottle_retail / SAFE_DIVIDE(s.bottle_volume_ml, 1000)) AS avg_per_liter_retail
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales` s
  JOIN top10_2021 t ON s.category_name = t.category_name
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date) IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    AND s.bottle_volume_ml > 0
  GROUP BY s.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.date)
)
SELECT 
  category_name,
  AVG(CASE WHEN yr = 2019 THEN avg_per_liter_retail END) AS avg_per_liter_2019,
  AVG(CASE WHEN yr = 2020 THEN avg_per_liter_retail END) AS avg_per_liter_2020,
  AVG(CASE WHEN yr = 2021 THEN avg_per_liter_retail END) AS avg_per_liter_2021
FROM category_yearly
GROUP BY category_name
ORDER BY avg_per_liter_2021 DESC

WITH paad_patients AS (

),
kras_pass AS (

  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),
tp53_pass AS (

  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' AND FILTER = 'PASS'
)
SELECT

SELECT

WITH candidate_committees AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cmte_id, cand_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_committee_2016`
  WHERE cand_election_yr = 2016
),
small_contributions AS (
  SELECT cmte_id, SUM(transaction_amt) as total_small_contributions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_contributions_2016`
  WHERE entity_tp = 'IND'
    AND transaction_amt > 0
    AND transaction_amt <= 200
  GROUP BY cmte_id
),
qualified_committees AS (
  SELECT cc.cmte_id, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.cand_id) as num_candidates, sc.total_small_contributions
  FROM candidate_committees cc
  INNER JOIN small_contributions sc ON cc.cmte_id = sc.cmte_id
  GROUP BY cc.cmte_id, sc.total_small_contributions
  HAVING sc.total_small_contributions > 0
    AND sc.total_small_contributions <= 200
)
SELECT c.cmte_nm AS committee_name,
       qc.num_candidates AS num_unique_candidates,
       STRING_AGG(cand.cand_name, ',' ORDER BY cand.cand_name) AS candidate_names,
       qc.total_small_contributions AS total_small_dollar_donations
FROM qualified_committees qc
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.committee_2016` c ON qc.cmte_id = c.cmte_id
LEFT JOIN candidate_committees cc ON qc.cmte_id = cc.cmte_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fec.candidate_2016` cand ON cc.cand_id = cand.cand_id
GROUP BY qc.cmte_id, c.cmte_nm, qc.num_candidates, qc.total_small_contributions

WITH 
overlaps AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    b.geo_id as blockgroup_id,
    b.area_land_meters as bg_area,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)) / ST_AREA(b.blockgroup_geom) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` b
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(z.zip_code_geom, b.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE z.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND b.state_fips_code = '08'
),
bank_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    COUNT(*) as total_banks
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
zip_concentrations AS (
  SELECT 
    o.zip_code,
    AVG(b.total_banks * o.overlap_ratio) as avg_banks_per_blockgroup
  FROM overlaps o
  JOIN bank_counts b ON o.zip_code = b.zip_code
  GROUP BY o.zip_code
)
SELECT zip_code, avg_banks_per_blockgroup
FROM zip_concentrations
ORDER BY avg_banks_per_blockgroup DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_title') as page_title,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') as page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    CASE 
      WHEN page_location LIKE '%/Office/%+%' THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN page_location LIKE '%/Stationery/%+%' THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN page_location LIKE '%/Notebooks+Journals/%+%' THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN page_location LIKE '%/Google+Redesign/%+%' THEN 'PDP'
      ELSE page_title
    END as display_title
  FROM page_views
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    display_title,
    LAG(display_title) OVER (ORDER BY rn) as prev_title
  FROM classified
),
merged AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    display_title
  FROM with_prev
  WHERE display_title != prev_title OR rn = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as num_pages, STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>' ORDER BY rn) as flow
FROM merged

WITH events AS (
  SELECT
    event_date,
    user_pseudo_id,
    traffic_source.medium,
    traffic_source.source,
    traffic_source.name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
session_channels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CONCAT(user_pseudo_id, '_', event_date) AS session_key,
    CASE
      WHEN medium = '(none)' AND source = '(direct)' THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN medium = '(not set)' AND source = '(direct)' THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yandex')
           AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yandex')
           AND medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'email' OR LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN source IN ('facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'twitter', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'badoo', 'whatsapp')
           AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN source IN ('facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'twitter', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'tiktok', 'badoo', 'whatsapp')
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN source IN ('youtube', 'vimeo', 'dailymotion', 'netflix', 'twitch', 'disneyplus')
           AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN source IN ('youtube', 'vimeo', 'dailymotion', 'netflix', 'twitch', 'disneyplus')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(medium), r'video') THEN 'Organic Video'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM events
),
channel_sessions AS (
  SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS sessions
  FROM session_channels
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel, sessions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sessions DESC) AS rank
FROM channel_sessions

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) AS first_open_shanghai
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180825' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'first_open'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING DATE(MIN(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR))) BETWEEN '2018-09-01' AND '2018-09-07'
),
user_first_open AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_open_shanghai,
    DATE(first_open_shanghai) AS first_open_date
  FROM cohort
),
user_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    ufo.user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE 
      WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
        TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR), 
        ufo.first_open_shanghai, DAY) BETWEEN 1 AND 7 
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS retained_week1,
    MAX(CASE 
      WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
        TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR), 
        ufo.first_open_shanghai, DAY) BETWEEN 8 AND 14 
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS retained_week2,
    MAX(CASE 
      WHEN TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
        TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR), 
        ufo.first_open_shanghai, DAY) BETWEEN 15 AND 21 
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END) AS retained_week3
  FROM user_first_open ufo
  LEFT JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON ufo.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181003'
    AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR) >= ufo.first_open_shanghai
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(e.event_timestamp), INTERVAL 8 HOUR), ufo.first_open_shanghai, DAY) BETWEEN 1 AND 21
  GROUP BY ufo.user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_week1), COUNT(*)) AS week_1_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_week2), COUNT(*)) AS week_2_retention_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_week3), COUNT(*)) AS week_3_retention_rate
FROM user_retention
